description: The end of a modular mixer's stereo bus: it takes the bus in, applies a level to it and sends it to the main outputs

params.text: Multiplies the bus by 0 to 2, leaving it unchanged at the centre
Turns the main outputs on and off; its lamp is lit while they are on

inputs.text: The left side of the stereo bus arriving from the last channel
The right side of the stereo bus arriving from the last channel

outputs.text: Copies the left side of the bus as it arrives, before the gain and the on button, for carrying on elsewhere
Copies the right side of the bus as it arrives, before the gain and the on button, for carrying on elsewhere
The left side of the bus after the gain and the on button
The right side of the bus after the gain and the on button

notes: the two columns of lamps are meters, one lamp for each volt to 10V, and the topmost one stays lit for a moment once that side passes 10V
the stereo bus of the last channel in the row goes into the bus inputs here, and the main outputs carry the whole mix

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
